newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dharmala Sakti unit closes $100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Dharmala Sakti unit closes $100 mln FRN.

text.p: DSS Overseas International BV's US$100 million floating rate note issue has been allotted, lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said Friday.
The deal is guaranteed by Dharmala Sakti Sejahtera.
The facility has a final maturity of three years. The issue was priced at par to float at 237.5 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 261 basis points.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is the lead manager.
Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia is the co-lead manager.
Asian Banking Corp, Coryo Merchant Bank, First Commercial Bank, Korea Merchant Banking Corp, Kyunki Bank, Peregrine Fixed Income and Samsam Merchant Bank are senior managers.
Yamaichi Merchant Bank Singapore and Union de Banques Arabes et Francaises Singapore are managers.
